venue.name: La Casa Vecchia & The Grey Lady

messages.label: Their reply
messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for La Casa Vecchia?
messages.body:
Hi Natalie,

Thanks for getting in touch, and sorry for the slow reply. Jake sounds like a good fit for us.

Saturdays through to Christmas are all taken by private parties, but Sundays are open - the 18th or 25th of October, or the 8th or 15th of November. We pause for December, and the new year is largely open, Saturdays included.

The way it works for a new act is the same as on our site (https://www.70-72thepantiles.co.uk/play-at-the-grey-lady/): rather than a fee, you keep every penny of the ticket money, and there's no venue hire fee. What we need from you in return is the audience. You send me a poster and a short description, we put the night up on our site and sell the tickets (or you sell them yourself if you'd rather), and we push it on our channels - but your own following is what fills the room, so we'd need you promoting it hard too. The one condition is that the audience spends at least £300 on food and drink on a Sunday to Thursday, or £1,200 on a Friday or Saturday.

If the first night goes well, we're happy to talk about a share of the bar and food takings for the next one. We'd rather build it up together.

If one of those dates suits Jake, let me know which and I'll hold it.

Thanks,
Caio
